relationship-repair-coach.note: Public content is replaced by a source-bounded repair-attempt protocol grounded in experimental and meta-analytic apology/forgiveness research. cbt-action-mood-tracker.note: Reviewed against NHS CBT and thought-record guidance. Public copy is an educational observation worksheet about situation, action and before/after experience; it is not presented as formal CBT, diagnosis, treatment, or proof of causality.

cardio-health-daily-habits.note: Reviewed against American Heart Association physical-activity guidance. Public copy is narrowed to planning movement toward the adult weekly activity baseline, with explicit adaptation to ability and professional medical advice.

daily-gratitude-journal-three-things.note: Reviewed against recent gratitude meta-analysis and systematic-review evidence. spaced-recall-coach.note: The effective public protocol was fully rewritten to match the reviewed distributed-practice boundary: separated study sessions for verbal material, spacing chosen in relation to the intended retention period, explicit uncertainty about exact intervals, and no claim of transfer beyond verbal recall.

ask-a-peer-to-proofread.note: Reviewed against Scherer, Graham, and Busse (2024), a meta-analysis of feedback in secondary-school and university L1, L2, and foreign-language writing. 30-min-eye-break-tracker.note: Public content is replaced by a low-risk screen-break checkpoint. Fixed timing, medical benefit claims, productivity claims and inherited evidence-like language are removed; the protocol is framed as a work-quality pause, not treatment.

478-breathing-technique-guide.note: Public content is replaced by a conservative unforced breathing pause. The inherited 4-7-8 prescription, treatment-like expectations and research-sounding claims are removed; users are told to stop if the exercise feels uncomfortable or causes light-headedness.

achieve-multiple-goals-at-once.note: Public content is replaced by a compatible-goals planning protocol. Unsupported multi-goal performance claims are removed and the user is instructed to separate goals when combining them weakens quality, attention, privacy or safety.

leave-an-app-review.note: Public content is replaced by a neutral observation-impact-suggestion feedback protocol. App-growth, engagement and outcome claims from inherited copy are not retained.

automatic-paycheck-to-savings.note: Public content is replaced by general financial-hygiene guidance for a small reversible savings automation. It explicitly preserves essential obligations and avoids individualized financial advice, savings-rate prescriptions and unsupported outcome claims.

challenge-generalizations-counterexample.note: Public content is replaced by a generic counterexample logic check. The legacy NLP collection is retained only as compatibility navigation; the protocol makes no claim that NLP is scientifically validated or necessary for the technique.

ancestral-torch-resilience-tracker.note: Public content is replaced by a short controllable-next-step reminder. Ancestry, resilience-performance and motivational outcome claims are removed; the phrase is kept only if it changes a concrete next action.

decision-calibration-journal.note: Public content is replaced by ordinary decision-calibration journaling. The legacy Quantum collection is explicitly separated from the protocol and no personal-decision claim is inferred from quantum mechanics.

ai-six-hats-facilitator.note: The inherited article contained unsupported effectiveness claims, invented team observations, fabricated timing and conversion examples, and arbitrary experiment thresholds. control-to-action-compass.note: The inherited article contained therapy and physiological framing, family-health examples, fabricated completion effects, fixed concern counts and timing rules. ai-speaking-practice-tracker.note: Retired from current guidance. Any Metkagram or Ptichi continuation requires a separately verified current contract owned by the destination project.

ready-to-resume-plan.note: Reviewed against Leroy & Glomb's interruption studies with convergent plan-making evidence from Masicampo & Baumeister. Public guidance is limited to creating a concrete resumption plan before leaving unfinished work. It does not claim that switching costs disappear, prescribe an exact note length, or promise a universal productivity effect.

visible-progress-monitoring.note: Reviewed against Harkin et al.'s meta-analysis of 138 randomized studies and 19,951 participants. Public guidance supports making goal progress observable and using it for adjustment, while explicitly avoiding claims that daily tracking, streaks, public leaderboards, or more monitoring are universally optimal.

if-then-rules-productivity.note: Legacy article replaced after review against the 2024 meta-analysis of 642 independent implementation-intention tests. Public guidance now uses the bounded contingent form If [observable cue], then I will [specific feasible response] and removes unsupported fixed counts, durations, effect sizes, stress claims, and productivity estimates.

stop-caffeine-after-lunch.note: The inherited fixed after-lunch cutoff and detailed dosing advice are replaced by a sourced, bedtime-relative and dose-aware sleep protocol. The reviewed 2025 randomized crossover trial supports concern about a single 400 mg dose reaching into sleep even when taken many hours before bedtime, but it does not justify a universal 1 p.m. cutoff, body-weight dosing, a claim that 100 mg four hours before bed is safe for everyone, or using sleep response to infer caffeine metabolism.

walking-meeting-assistant.note: The inherited walking-meeting article is replaced by a sourced implementation protocol for interrupting a prolonged sitting block with actual movement when a meeting can safely travel. The newly reviewed Vanherle 2026 systematic review/meta-analyses and the already-reviewed Gale 2026 meta-analysis support acute glucose and insulin benefits from physical-activity breaks, with walking showing a useful signal. They do not establish a special walking-meeting effect, a universal 20-minute interval, long-term disease prevention, or the inherited step-count, heart-rate, creativity, wind-noise, and battery-drain claims.

grayscale-phone-friction.note: Reviewed against the complete 2026 Frontiers cross-over feasibility trial. Public guidance is limited to grayscale as a reversible screen-time-friction experiment. The study did not establish durable effects or consistent productivity, sleep, or mental-health benefits.

batch-non-urgent-notifications.note: Reviewed against the complete 2019 randomized field experiment. Public guidance preserves the tested mechanism—predictable batching of non-urgent notifications—while rejecting three batches per day as a universal optimum and preserving urgent bypasses.

deliberate-email-checking-windows.note: Reviewed against the complete 2015 experimental field report. The direct causal claim is lower stress under less-frequent email checking; productivity and broader wellbeing are not presented as directly proven outcomes, and three checks per day is not treated as an optimal dose.

savor-positive-moment.note: Reviewed against the 2026 systematic review and three-level meta-analysis of 20 randomized trials. The public practice is a conservative implementation of the savoring construct, not a claim that this exact micro-protocol, duration, or clinical use was established by the meta-analysis.

post-meal-walk.note: Reviewed against the preregistered systematic review and meta-analysis of eight randomized crossover trials. Guidance is restricted to safe, practical post-meal movement as an option with an acute postprandial-glucose signal; no universal duration, exact start time, long-term prevention, or treatment claim is made.

genuine-micro-conversation.note: Reviewed against the complete field-experiment report. Public guidance is limited to making an already-occurring low-pressure interaction slightly more social when the other person appears willing. It does not claim loneliness treatment, social-anxiety treatment, or benefits in contexts where conversation is intrusive or impractical.

consider-the-opposite.note: Reviewed against the complete classic consider-the-opposite experiments and a 2025 meta-analysis of educational debiasing RCTs. The strategy is presented as a bounded check against one-sided reasoning, not a general immunity to cognitive bias or proof of real-world transfer.

temptation-bundling.note: Reviewed against the original randomized gym field experiment and a later large exercise field experiment. Public guidance keeps the strongest evidence tied to compatible rewards and exercise/task initiation, makes effect decay explicit, and does not generalize the method to every habit.

prequestions-before-learning.note: Reviewed against the 2025 multilevel meta-analysis. Public guidance is restricted to improved learning for information explicitly targeted by prequestions; the near-zero non-target effect, lack of a universal question dose, and role of feedback remain explicit boundaries.

self-explain-what-you-learn.note: Reviewed against the 2025 three-level meta-analysis of self-explanation in digital learning environments. Public guidance keeps the digital-learning scope, heterogeneity, pacing and knowledge-type moderation, and does not claim one universal prompt, modality, frequency, or superiority over other learning strategies.

apply-80-20-principle.note: The inherited Pareto article contained pseudo-precise effect sizes, arbitrary work intervals, fabricated observations, and ROI-style claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded prioritization experiment. The 80/20 ratio is treated as a heuristic for looking for concentration, not a law, forecast, or effectiveness claim.

batch-similar-tasks-planner.note: The inherited batching article contained unsupported productivity percentages, invented switching costs, rigid batch durations, and fabricated observations. The effective public record is rewritten as a reversible workflow experiment that explicitly checks delay, errors, urgency, and responsiveness before expanding batching.

adopt-new-tools-at-work.note: The inherited tool-adoption article contained fabricated pilots, unsupported adoption metrics, medical-adjacent examples, and arbitrary success thresholds. The effective public record is rewritten as a low-risk tool-evaluation protocol with a reversible pilot, explicit criteria, fallback, and exclusion of safety-critical or regulated use without the relevant approval process.

ai-question-bank-builder.note: The inherited learning article contained unsupported effect percentages, rigid question ratios, fixed timing prescriptions, and research-sounding claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a source-checked question-authoring workflow: AI drafts questions, while the learner verifies every answer against the source. No literature-backed effectiveness claim is made by this editorial classification.

break-big-goals-into-steps.note: The inherited goal-decomposition article contained unsupported completion-rate claims, fabricated experiments, arbitrary duration rules, and broad motivational promises. The effective public record is rewritten as a concrete decomposition protocol based on finish conditions, dependencies, observable deliverables, and iterative replanning.

break-down-big-problems-triz.note: The inherited TRIZ article contained pseudo-quantified outcomes, fabricated pilots, arbitrary timing rules, and broad superiority claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded TRIZ-inspired problem-structuring exercise using contradiction and separation prompts. It is not presented as the full TRIZ method or as an evidence-backed effect-size claim.

aida-message-optimizer.note: The inherited AIDA article contained unsupported response-rate improvements, fabricated A/B outcomes, and formula-like persuasion claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a message-clarity checklist for relevance, understanding, honest value, and one explicit next action. No conversion guarantee is implied.

attention-to-detail-trainer.note: The inherited article contained unsupported perception statistics, fabricated improvement timelines, invented pilot outcomes, and people-observation prompts. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded artifact-verification routine using known failure modes, a second pass, anomaly logging, and checklist improvement.

automate-routine-data-reports.note: The inherited report-automation article contained fabricated team savings, unsupported reliability targets, arbitrary engineering thresholds, and broad automation claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a report-automation readiness protocol with source ownership, validation, visible failures, a manual fallback, and an explicit stop on invalid publication.

qa-checklist-templates-runbook.note: The inherited QA article contained fabricated release observations, unsupported defect-rate claims, rigid checklist-size rules, and invented benchmarks. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded checklist-design and execution protocol with explicit expected results, exception handling, ownership, and checklist revision after real misses.

structure-writing-with-visuals.note: The inherited writing article contained fabricated usability observations, unsupported comprehension and support-ticket improvements, and arbitrary layout thresholds. The effective public record is rewritten as a document-structure review protocol in which headings, tables, diagrams, and images are chosen only when they answer a reader question or make a relationship easier to inspect.

chef-taste-and-adjust.note: The inherited cooking article contained fabricated kitchen/lab outcomes, pseudo-precise seasoning rules, unsupported physiological claims, and unsafe overgeneralization of tasting. The effective public record is rewritten as a conservative taste-and-adjust workflow for food that is already safe to taste, with one change at a time and explicit food-safety boundaries.

build-your-support-network.note: The inherited support-network article contained fabricated response rates and observational samples, rigid contact targets, broad psychological claims, and pseudo-optimized social scripts. The effective public record is rewritten as a consent- and boundary-aware method for matching a concrete need to an appropriate person, making a specific optional request, and avoiding overreliance on one relationship.

ergonomic-workspace-assessment.note: The inherited workspace article contained unsupported productivity and discomfort outcomes, pseudo-medical posture rules, rigid dimensions and timing prescriptions, and fabricated observations. The effective public record is narrowed to a workspace-friction audit: identify the task, map reach/visibility/glare/cable/setup friction, change one reversible layout variable, and keep only changes that make the work easier to perform without creating a new problem. It is not treatment or injury-prevention guidance.

affirmation-habit-tracker.note: The inherited affirmation article mixed therapy-adjacent framing with unsupported behavioral outcomes, fabricated first-party observations, rigid repetition schedules, and a selectively presented literature claim. The effective public record is narrowed to drafting a grounded self-statement that is presently credible and linked to one action under the user's control. No health outcome is asserted.

coot-ai-growth-journal.note: The inherited Coot.AI article contained obsolete product-specific framing, fabricated completion-rate observations, pseudo-optimized session lengths, mental-health-adjacent language, and unsupported claims that a chat increases follow-through. The effective public record is rewritten as a vendor-neutral AI reflection workflow: define the decision, provide constraints, ask for options and failure modes, verify factual claims, choose one reversible next action, and keep the human responsible for the decision.

process-of-elimination-tracker.note: The inherited article contained fabricated decision-time and satisfaction statistics, invented first-party observations, and arbitrary numeric rules presented as if generally validated. The effective public record is narrowed to a low-stakes decision workflow: state real constraints, eliminate only clear failures, separate unknowns from failures, compare survivors, and use a reversible information-gaining step when uncertainty remains.

plan-tasks-by-peak-energy.note: The inherited article mixed unsupported chronobiology effect sizes with fabricated productivity observations, caffeine and nutrition prescriptions, health-adjacent advice, and rigid timing claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a self-observation and scheduling experiment: observe normal workdays, find a tentative personal window, move one demanding task, and keep the scheduling rule only when the user's own work results and coordination costs justify it.

oblique-strategies-prompt-cards.note: The inherited article contained fabricated internal pilots, completion-rate and idea-count effects, pseudo-optimal deck sizes and timers, and overclaimed mechanisms for creativity. The effective public record is narrowed to a reversible prompt-constraint exercise: name the stuck artifact, introduce one safe constraint, create a separate variant, and keep only changes that improve the actual brief.

phase-transition-ritual-tracker.note: The inherited article presented a physics analogy as a behavioral mechanism and included fabricated field trials, self-report effects, arbitrary optimized durations, and health-adjacent breathing or mobility prescriptions. The effective public record is rewritten as a context-handoff checklist: preserve the unfinished state, make one visible closing move, name the first action of the next mode, and keep the handoff only when it reduces practical switching friction.

communication-blocks-scheduler.note: The inherited article used unsupported switching and time-savings figures, rigid message schedules, and fabricated observations. The effective public record is narrowed to a role-aware batching workflow: map actual response obligations, batch only routine traffic that can wait, preserve a clear escalation path, convert substantial requests into tasks, and revise the schedule when it harms delivery or coordination.

top-3-daily-focus-planner.note: The inherited article contained fabricated completion samples, unsupported habit and estimation claims, universal time budgets, and fixed scheduling prescriptions. The effective public record treats up to three outcomes as a visible capacity boundary rather than an optimal number: scan obligations, choose a small outcome set, define done, park the rest visibly, and re-plan explicitly when urgent work changes the day.

default-choice-audit.note: The inherited article contained unsupported uptake effects, invented interruption savings and annualized impact, fabricated personal observations, arbitrary review cadences, and overgeneralized conclusions. The effective public record is a bounded default-choice audit: inspect consequential defaults, state the requirement first, compare realistic alternatives and switching costs, keep or change deliberately, and record rollback when it matters.

judge-decisions-by-process.note: The inherited article mixed unsupported decision-quality effects with invented timing and memory thresholds, fabricated first-party results, arbitrary scores, and emotional-regulation instructions. The effective public record is narrowed to reconstructing what was actually known at the decision point, separating later information, inspecting concrete process strengths and omissions, and carrying one process improvement into the next similar decision.

qa-clear-feedback-templates.note: The inherited QA article contained fabricated engineering results, unsupported cycle-time reductions, pseudo-optimal evidence quantities, invented social effects, and universal prescriptions. The effective public record is a defect-reporting handoff: observable behavior, relevant context, reliable reproduction information, focused redacted diagnostics, explicitly labeled hypotheses, expected behavior, and a narrow acceptance check.

creativity-within-constraints.note: The inherited creativity article included unsupported mechanisms, fabricated output comparisons and observations, physiological engagement claims, pseudo-optimal session lengths, and arbitrary completion targets. The effective public record treats a constraint only as a reversible way to generate a different draft: constrain one dimension, create a variant, and keep only changes that improve the actual brief.

daily-priority-review-coach.note: The inherited task-review article contained fabricated cohorts and retention results, unsupported time-savings, arbitrary review durations and archival thresholds, and pseudo-optimized task counts. The effective public record is a task-list maintenance workflow: scan the active horizon, close or park stale work, clarify next actions and blockers, choose a small current attention set, and stop before review becomes execution.

weekly-goal-review-coach.note: The inherited weekly-review article contained fabricated adherence and execution results, unsupported optimal review windows, pseudo-precise time leverage, health-related examples, and arbitrary metric targets. The effective public record is a bounded operational review: inspect active commitments, compare intended and actual progress, identify the main changed constraint, make explicit continue/stop/shrink/move/delegate decisions, and schedule the first resulting action.

separate-to-decide-decision-evaluator.note: The inherited decision article mixed unsupported cognitive mechanisms with fabricated team outcomes, invented satisfaction and speed effects, arbitrary universal timeboxes and score scales, and examples in higher-stakes domains. The effective public record is narrowed to criteria stability: define requirements first, evaluate each option against the same list, keep unknowns explicit, remove clear must-have failures, then compare meaningful trade-offs.

active-listening-coach.note: The inherited active-listening article contained unsupported interpersonal effects, fabricated observations, culture-insensitive eye-contact and nodding prescriptions, physiological timing instructions, and pseudo-precise behavioral quotas. The effective public record is an accessible comprehension check: let the relevant thought finish, summarize the meaning, invite correction, update understanding, and respond to the corrected version without prescribing nonverbal behavior.

conversational-storytelling-coach.note: The inherited storytelling article contained unsupported recall and credibility effects, fabricated training outcomes, pseudo-optimal story lengths and beat timing, and overgeneralized listener-state prescriptions. The effective public record is a relevance-and-privacy workflow: state the point, choose one directly relevant real example, compress it to necessary context and change, connect it back to the current topic, and remove unnecessary identifying or confidential detail.

ai-professional-writing-draft.note: Reviewed against Noy & Zhang (Science, 2023). Task-specific randomized evidence supports faster and higher-rated mid-level professional writing with ChatGPT. The Brali protocol keeps factual verification and final accountability human and does not generalize the effect to every writing task.

ai-idea-divergence-pass.note: Reviewed against Lee & Chung (Nature Human Behaviour, 2024). Multi-experiment evidence supports higher judged creativity on several ideation tasks. The protocol is limited to option generation; feasibility, selection and implementation remain separate judgments.

ai-task-frontier-test.note: Reviewed against Dell'Acqua et al. on the jagged technological frontier. The evidence supports task-level evaluation and warns against assuming capability transfers to adjacent tasks. This protocol operationalizes that boundary through representative cases and acceptance criteria.

ai-customer-reply-coach.note: Reviewed against Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond (QJE, 2025). Large-scale field evidence supports productivity gains for a specific human-in-the-loop customer-support assistant. The protocol preserves human diagnosis, policy checking, tone and accountability.

ai-code-scaffold-test-loop.note: Reviewed against Peng et al. (2023). A controlled coding experiment supports a speed signal on one bounded task. The source is not treated as proof of universal software quality, security or maintainability gains; tests and diff review are explicit gates.

ai-learning-attempt-feedback-retest.note: Reviewed against the 2026 systematic review/meta-analysis plus the cited 2025 RCT. The review found no stable overall positive learning effect after robust publication-bias correction and highlighted heterogeneity plus augmentation/substitution differences. The protocol therefore preserves learner effort and an unaided retest.

ai-source-summary-verification.note: Reviewed against experimental evidence on overreliance on incorrect AI advice. The source is used only to justify an independent verification boundary; the protocol makes no claim that AI summaries are reliably complete or factual.

ai-meeting-notes-to-actions.note: Practical transformation workflow with privacy and reconciliation gates. Owners, decisions and dates must come from the meeting record rather than model inference.

ai-test-case-generator.note: AI output is treated only as candidate failure modes. The protocol requires verification and conversion into executable tests or checks before the ideas become QA evidence.

ai-decision-alternatives.note: Reviewed against experimental evidence that people can over-rely on incorrect AI advice. The evidence is used to justify independent criteria and verification; high-stakes decision authority is explicitly excluded.

ai-rubric-critique.note: Practical feedback workflow. The user defines the rubric, inspects evidence behind the critique and accepts or rejects changes; no universal superiority claim is made.

ai-conversation-rehearsal.note: Low-risk role-play protocol for ordinary communication practice. It explicitly rejects prediction of another person's mind and avoids therapy or treatment claims.

ai-structured-extraction-check.note: Practical information-extraction workflow with traceability, visible uncertainty and consequence-weighted verification; no generic accuracy rate is claimed.

ai-sop-from-examples.note: Practical knowledge-capture workflow. Generated procedure text must be reviewed by the operator and tested on a fresh case before adoption.
